limitations: LLM judge scores vary; results from different runs are not combined into one overall grade.
Reviewer identities are demo role labels; production authentication and authorization are not implemented.
Notifications are simulations; no messages are sent.
The local audit trail is durable but not tamper-proof.
The parallel-review UI batches both selections; the backend also supports independently addressed responses.
Canvas submission and PR merge remain under user control.

browser_checks: Required request details block advancement when empty
Closing and reopening retains the in-page draft
Back navigation retains earlier request and business-case fields
Urgent priority requires an urgency reason before review

Evidence unavailable is an explicit requester choice and is preserved in the submitted case
Review screen shows amount, department, priority, current situation, evidence, impact and alternatives
Successful submission closes and resets the form
Live low-risk request completed through automatic budget validation
Live medium-risk request exposed Manager Review without the request dialog blocking it
Fictitious human-review test was rejected to leave no pending test decision
